item.title: Kindness still thrives: Readers share heartwarming stranger stories
item.description: We asked readers for tales of unexpected kindness from strangers. Their responses show compassion is alive and well.

item.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner to visit Kyiv after Moscow talks
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are scheduled to arrive in Kyiv on Sunday, marking their first trip to the Ukrainian capital amid renewed diplomatic efforts.

item.title: Halal Texas barbecue gains popularity among American Muslims
item.description: Despite rising anti-Muslim sentiment in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are attracting diners and transforming a beloved local food tradition.

item.title: Quiz: Test your knowledge on procrastination and how to beat it
item.description: Take this quiz to learn surprising facts about procrastination and discover tools to overcome it, based on insights from social scientist Itamar Shatz.
